text_block_list.text:
During training, Mejiro Ryan got injured, 
so I quickly brought her to the nurse's 
office.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer... It seems I got a 
little too carried away...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... To think I can't even manage my 
own body...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...If McQueen finds out, she'll definitely 
be exasperated...

...Seeing her unusually timid, I searched 
for the right words to say.
choice_data_list:
Don't rush; just focus on healing up 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Steadily, without rushing... huh? 
You're... right, aren't you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, no time to be sniffling around.

Mejiro Ryan slapped both of her cheeks 
with her hands to psych herself up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Alright, switch gears, switch gears!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... running training is the 
best way to change up my mood, though...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Urrrgh, no, no! Don't think about running!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Endure it... Just endure it...

...So that the day would come when she 
could train to her heart's content again, 
I decided to have her take a proper rest 
for the day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry. You're right, what a weird 
thought for me to have.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sickness is all in the mind, all in 
the mind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...When energy is basically my only 
strong point, I can't afford to be acting 
so timid, right...?"

—However, perhaps rushing caused even more 
stress, as her condition remained poor in 
the days that followed, prolonging the 
treatment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Panicking won't help anything, so at times 
like this, a nice change of pace is in 
order...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, come to think of it, did a new 
volume come out?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: N-No! It's nothing! Ah, ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it, it ended right after 
the confession, didn't it~! I wonder 
what's gonna happen next!?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(...I'll read some shoujo manga tonight to 
cheer myself up!)

...At any rate, Mejiro Ryan was back in 
high spirits the next day, and resumed 
training right away.
